title: Scanning the Hold
summary: Get to know a real dataset with str(), head(), summary() and names().
hints: Run `str(penguins)` and `summary(penguins)` on their own lines and read the output.
`nrow()` and `ncol()` give the size; `names()` gives the variable names.
Look in the `summary()` output for `NA's` under `body_mass_g`.
